This is a local experimental build, not a reviewed public distribution.
Before redistribution, review the licenses, notices, source availability, and
other obligations for all bundled components and their dependencies.

  https://github.com/pyodide/pyodide/tree/0.27.7
- Python: Python Software Foundation License and other bundled licenses:
  https://docs.python.org/3/license.html
- PyInstaller: its bootloader exception is described at
  https://pyinstaller.org/en/stable/license.html
- pystray 0.19.5: GNU Lesser General Public License v3. Source and license:
  https://github.com/moses-palmer/pystray/tree/v0.19.5
  Review the obligations for the bundled application before redistribution.
- Pillow: the bundled package metadata contains its license. Source:
  https://github.com/python-pillow/Pillow
- Scientific Python packages and transitive dependencies: see the METADATA and

The application's own license is included separately in `LICENSE`.
